title: Easier closing of expanded vehicle listings
summary: Expanded vehicle listings now keep their close control in a predictable position, including on phones.
fixes: The close button stays at the top-right of the listing header instead of wrapping beneath vehicle details. Titles and archive information have their own space so the control remains easy to reach.

title: Listing prices for signed-in members
summary: Signed-in members can see recorded store prices alongside available vehicles and retain that information when reviewing archived releases.
additions: Available vehicle cards show the recorded price and currency when you are signed in, including on the homepage. Visitors who are signed out do not receive pricing information.
improvements: Sold-out cards keep their compact appearance. Open the archived vehicle details while signed in to see its last listed price, when recorded. Prices are shown only when the store supplies an explicit amount and currency.

title: A more compact workspace with more ways to make it yours
summary: Everfall Limited Watcher now brings related information closer together, puts useful controls within easier reach, and offers more ways to shape page content. The refinements extend from server management and administrative tools to public pages, previews, and recovery screens.
highlights: Dashboard summaries use less space on phones, with related counts arranged together. Administrator Overview brings recent deliveries closer to the top, while Bot Control and Status Widgets give their main action a clearer place.
Choose from 204 icons with category filters, purpose-based search, keyboard browsing, and clear previews. Existing icon choices remain supported, and sections can still use no icon.
additions: Customize your workspace with compact or comfortable spacing and focused or wide content. These choices affect your current browser view only and reset on reload.
Find pages and tools from the header search button or Ctrl/Command K. Search results reflect the pages available to your account.
Additional page sections now offer content-width, icon-size, and primary or outline button options, with the same appearance in preview and on the published page.
improvements: Connected server rows emphasize names, channels, and useful status. Technical IDs and copy controls are available through expandable connection details, keeping the main list easier to scan.
Secondary operations sit in consistent menus. Bot-wide synchronization and bulk widget refresh show what will happen before you continue.
Public sections and footers have more consistent spacing and typography. Page editors can hide previews while working, and phone previews start collapsed to put editing controls closer to hand.
fixes: Failed requests offer clearer retry paths, and existing information remains available during refresh failures. Page editing pauses if saved content cannot be loaded, protecting published pages from accidental replacement.

Leaving Pages with unsaved work now offers a stay-or-leave choice. Canceling a failed edit clears stale failure feedback, and unavailable profile images use a clean fallback instead of a broken image.

title: Smoother sign-in and clearer Discord profiles
summary: Signing in and finding contact information is easier, with clearer Discord profile cards and more control over the bot's visible activity.
additions: Administrators can configure the bot's Discord presence and activity from Bot Control. Saved settings are synchronized with its Discord status.
The About page includes a creator contact card with profile details and a GitHub link for finding the project.
improvements: Discord profile cards and the account menu have clearer names, profile details, and layouts that adapt to smaller screens.
fixes: The Discord sign-in window opens directly when you select login, reducing popup-blocking problems. Full-page sign-in remains available when the browser blocks the window.

title: A clearer sidebar with everything closer to hand
summary: Finding the right page is easier with a more organized sidebar. The Everfall Limited Watcher logo and title now take you straight to the homepage on mobile and desktop, so the extra shortcut at the bottom is no longer needed.
highlights: Administrator tools are grouped into Discord & Servers, Listings & Media, Website & Content, and Monitoring & Testing. Overview remains a direct link, and your current page automatically reveals its group.
improvements: Groups expand smoothly, chevrons show their state, and the current page has a clearer highlight. Your open groups and sidebar width choices stay in place as you move between pages.
The compact desktop sidebar offers labeled group menus, while mobile keeps the title within reach above a separately scrolling list. Keyboard focus and reduced-motion preferences are supported.
fixes: The mobile sidebar title now works as a homepage link, matching desktop behavior. Long navigation lists no longer push the title out of reach.

title: Easier recovery, dependable previews, and smoother browsing
summary: This update makes server management easier to diagnose and recover, keeps test-event previews consistent with what gets deployed, and helps you return to the exact archive view you were browsing. Release-note editing also gains stronger protection for work in progress.
highlights: A failed widget no longer holds up other widgets in the same server. Managers can retry an individual failed event or widget operation, with clearer explanations of what went wrong.

Test events now deploy the exact vehicles and cover shown in their saved preview. Previews remain valid for ten minutes, and events ended directly in Discord are recognized when their status is reloaded.
additions: Check Permissions explains missing access before enabling new automation. Server customization panels show the last check, last successful check, and when sticky widgets next become eligible to move.
Archive searches, stock filters, and page numbers are included in the address, making filtered views shareable and preserving them through reloads and vehicle-detail navigation.
improvements: Pages load their own interface code as needed, and archive search waits briefly for you to finish typing before requesting results. Repeated event-cover previews reuse unchanged images to avoid unnecessary work.
The Changelog checks for new updates every minute while open and includes a manual refresh control with the last refresh time.
Leaving the release editor with unsaved changes now offers a choice to stay and finish editing. Creating the same release version simultaneously cannot silently replace the first saved version.
fixes: Missing messages can no longer be recorded as successfully pinned. Failed operations remain visible for diagnosis and recovery.
Test previews reject changed settings and expired selections instead of silently generating a different cover during deployment. Updating an archived image also refreshes the cached cover.

title: Release notes that arrive with each update
summary: Keeping up with Everfall Limited Watcher is easier. Member release notes now travel with the update itself, bringing clear explanations of new features and everyday improvements to the Changelog when that update is deployed.
highlights: Published updates can now include their member release notes automatically, helping keep the website Changelog in step with the application.
improvements: Release notes continue to focus on changes you can see and use, with features, additions, improvements, and fixes grouped for easier reading.
Administrators can still refine published wording or withdraw a version from member view using the existing release editor.

title: More control, clearer previews, and easier server setup
summary: This update makes Everfall Limited Watcher more comfortable to use on smaller screens and gives server owners more ways to keep their communities informed. It also brings a more flexible public site and a safer way to try listing events before using them with your community.
highlights: The dashboard now adapts more naturally when space is limited. Navigation, action buttons, forms, and data rows are easier to reach on smaller displays, helping you manage your server without constantly moving sideways across a page.

Listing events can bring the vehicles in a release together in one place, with a generated cover showing up to three vehicles. Server managers can choose whether to enable automatic events and whether those events should end when the vehicles are no longer available.
additions: Server customizations now include options for pinning new listing messages, pinning the live widget, and keeping the widget closer to recent channel activity. Each server controls its own preferences.

A dedicated event simulator lets administrators choose a test server, preview one-, two-, or three-vehicle covers, and create a clearly labeled test event for a chosen amount of time. Test events can also be ended early.
This Changelog keeps members informed with versioned release notes explaining what has changed and how those changes affect everyday use.
improvements: Public pages have more flexible sections, clearer visibility controls, editable icons, and previews for different screen sizes. Hiding a section keeps its saved content ready for later.
The page editor saves changes automatically and shows whether work is waiting, saving, saved, or needs another attempt. Pages can be edited independently without replacing changes on another page.
Sold-out widget items take you to the preserved vehicle record. Opening a direct history link shows the full listing immediately, and closing it returns to the archive.
fixes: Improved the handling of high-resolution images when building multi-vehicle event covers, reducing unnecessary image work and keeping repeated test samples efficient.
Updated labels and status explanations so it is easier to understand when widgets change and which settings affect only the information shown on the website.

title: More flexible pages and announcement recovery
summary: This update expands the information available on the public website and gives administrators more ways to manage pages, widgets, and existing announcements.
additions: Dedicated Features and About pages explain what Everfall Limited Watcher does and how it helps communities follow limited vehicles.
Administrators can manage public page content in one Pages editor and recover announcement tracking from existing Discord messages.
improvements: Expanded announcement and widget controls make it easier to review presentation and manage existing deployments.
Widget synchronization checks for changes in the verified catalog, reducing unnecessary updates when listing information has stayed the same.

title: Live stock widgets for your Discord server
summary: Keep current vehicle availability within reach in Discord with an interactive stock widget and clearer server management tools.
highlights: Live stock widgets bring vehicle availability into a Discord channel and provide interactive controls for browsing listings.
additions: Preview a widget and confirm its deployment before a message is posted to your server.
Server management tools provide more control over widget deployments and clearer information about server configuration.
improvements: Administrators can review bot readiness and command registration to help diagnose setup problems.
Public pages include clearer page descriptions and link-preview information when shared.

title: Easier vehicle browsing and clearer monitoring information
summary: Finding and inspecting vehicles is more convenient, while administrators gain a clearer view of recent monitoring activity.
additions: Vehicle previews open a closer inspection view, with expandable listing details and time-limited listing labels.
A creator profile card makes profile information available from the public interface.
improvements: Homepage filters and listing summaries make it easier to focus on vehicles that interest you.
Monitoring and delivery logs use pages so administrators can review activity without scrolling through one long list.
fixes: Improved logout handling so leaving a signed-in session behaves more consistently.

title: A dedicated dashboard and vehicle archive
summary: Everfall Limited Watcher gains a more complete web interface for browsing vehicle history and managing Discord server settings.
highlights: Signed-in members can browse the vehicle history archive, search listings, and inspect vehicle galleries beyond the homepage showcase.
Server managers have a dedicated dashboard for reviewing their servers and configuring notification channels and roles.
improvements: A shared dark interface brings consistent navigation, cards, forms, and dialogs across public pages and the dashboard.
Dedicated administrator pages bring server oversight, announcement presentation, monitoring activity, and test tools into one interface.

title: Introducing Everfall Limited Watcher
summary: Follow limited vehicle listings from the website and Discord, with vehicle galleries and a preserved record of previously verified listings.
highlights: The homepage showcases limited vehicles with image galleries, while Discord announcements bring listing details into configured server channels.
Verified listing history is preserved when a store check fails or returns an unrecognized page, avoiding false sell-out changes from an inconclusive response.
additions: Discord sign-in connects server managers to settings for the servers they can manage, with creator administration kept separate.
Server-specific announcement settings let communities choose how listing information is presented.
fixes: Corrected a Discord sign-in redirect loop so authorized users can reach their dashboard.
